HOME SCIENCE MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)

16. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)

22. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only
